creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Parent for phase 1 of the design in `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`. Before anything reads across boards, kan has to stop writing during reads, keep its project registry clean, and never lose a card to an ID collision.

Each child follows `AGENTS.md`: a schema bump takes the full checklist, and a CLI change updates `extras/skill/SKILL.md` and `web/src/docs/cli.md`.
title: Phase 1: foundations for links and work across boards
